response.overview: Lia (Meriam Bellina) and Rizal (Ray Sahetapy) intend to build a life together as best they can. Circumstances don’t allow it. Rizal is fired from his job. He then meets Reggie (Dian Nitami), the daughter of a major businessman. Reggie, who has a crush on Rizal, suggests to her father that he immediately hire Rizal as a manager. In short, the two begin dating. Rizal’s best friend, Rino (Rano Karno), warns him about his behavior, but Rizal ignores him. In fact, Rizal marries Reggie because she is pregnant. It turns out that this marriage is rife with conflict, while Lia has reached a high level in her career and, because she often exchanges ideas with Rino, they eventually fall in love. Rizal is left feeling adrift.
response.title: Sejak Cinta Diciptakan
